method: Viewed 360 original-source frames on 36 contact sheets sampled every 0.5 sec, 0..4.5 sec. Actual media dimensions/count/fps read using OpenCV. No full-motion playback or alpha output QA performed. Suggested trim/event/anchor numbers are approximate candidates for downstream dense-frame review, not accepted production metadata.
globalRules: Use a single scale per source based on initial upright body height, never rescale each frame bbox.
Remove source camera/global actor root motion separately from intentional local limb/body deformation. Airborne ground shadows are not foot-root coordinates.
Target reference character height may be 80–110px in current room; art canvas padding need not match physics collider.
Do not apply one neutral-background matte recipe to walls, membrane, swim, door or hit-target clips without masks.
Source runtime retiming is necessary: source seconds are not gameplay wind-up or recovery.
No loop candidate here has been verified by playback, so treat as candidate and inspect last-to-first seam after root registration.
